thread:
sophia: Quick review pls — co-branded solution brief + 3 social tile variations for Nimbus Cloud. Figma + PDF in Drive. Need legal OK and final Nimbus logos by EOD Thu. Can we get a quick pass?

matt: Opening the brief now. Overall looks solid. Two logo notes: left align Redwood lockup on page 1, and avoid placing Nimbus wordmark over photos.

tara: Uploaded updated tiles with transparent Nimbus mark and dark/bg variants: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/redd-nimbus-tiles — filenames: social_tile_v1.png, social_tile_v2.png, social_tile_v3.png, logo_lockup_v3.svg.

alex: We still need the 2-line partner quote for the one-pager — can someone confirm who owns that?

sophia: I asked Nimbus last week; partner rep is on PTO until Wed. I pinged them again now. If legal needs their explicit sign-off on wordmark usage, timeline might slip.

legal-bot: Heads-up from Legal: using Nimbus wordmark requires partner approval + co-marketing addendum per clause 4.2. Marked the doc with comments: https://docs.google.com/xxx. @sophia please confirm when partner signs.

matt: Can we ship a landing page without the joint tiles if approvals lag? Might be ok, but partner asked for joint launch.

tara: If Nimbus can't approve the wordmark variant, we can use their brand lockup from partner kit instead — I added the permitted files to Drive. Permitted colors from kit: ```#1E3A8A, #00A3E0, #F6F8FB``` Also added PNGs with clear space guides.

sophia: Action items: (1) Design to incorporate lockup + alt colors (tara). (2) Alex to secure partner quote and confirm who signs addendum. (3) Legal to confirm exact addendum language and whether we can ship without wordmark. I’ll update GTM calendar. Deadline: EOD Thu if partner responds, otherwise Wed next week. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Reviewed updated draft — Legal requires partner to sign the co-marketing addendum before we publish joint logos. Added a checklist comment in the doc.

matt: Tiny copy nit on p3, change "deploys in minutes" -> "deploys across clouds in minutes" — makes it less ambiguous.

tara: Made the copy tweak and exported final assets (PDF + PNGs + SVGs). Upload: https://drive.google.com/updated_assets_export.zip. I included both light/dark bg tiles and a version with only Redwood branding if we need a single-brand fallback.

sophia: Perfect — I’ll follow up with Nimbus first thing Wed and update the launch window. If partner approves addendum quickly we schedule joint tweet + marketplace update. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
